title: Arizona State receiver Jordyn Tyson will work out for NFL teams six days before the draft

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Arizona State receiver Jordyn Tyson will work out for NFL teams six days before the draft
sources.description: Arizona State's Jordyn Tyson, one of the most talented and injury-prone wide receivers in the 2026 NFL draft, wants to show NFL teams that he's healthy and running at full speed.
